children: A leadership shakeup and job cuts follow an estimated 25% drop in new monthly subscribers, to 1.2 mln, over the past year. Its botched Warner Bros deal also accentuated struggles that evoke ones the streamer inflicted on cable TV. Absent creative sparks, a similar fate awaits.
Full view will be published shortly.
Follow Jennifer Saba on Bluesky and LinkedIn.
Netflix is due to report its quarterly financial results on October 20, with revenue expected to grow 12% from a year earlier, according to estimates compiled by LSEG.
The streaming service cut 6% of its workforce, or 1,000 employees, its biggest reduction since 2022, Reuters reported on October 14, citing an internal memo.
